name: paseo-slp
description: Supervisor → Lead → Peer room for Paseo (requires Paseo) — you talk only to the Supervisor; it pins down your intent, launches Lead agents via create_agent, and keeps them and their Peers on course, watching on a heartbeat for drift and bringing decisions back to you. Each Lead delegates to Peers (Claude at the cheapest capable tier, Codex for cross-family review), debates their evidence-based challenges, and gets an independent review before accepting.
